summary.text: The super dream realm is the giant dream realm in Southern Border that traps Spectral Soul's main body and later draws righteous path exploration behind a super Gu formation.

claims.text: From Heavenly Court’s perspective, Spectral Soul’s main body is trapped in Southern Border’s super dream realm. Heavenly Court does not and cannot act there, and can only watch as Spectral Soul dies slowly in the dream realm.

After Chi Qu You completes the super Gu formation that conceals the site, Southern Border righteous path Gu Immortals argue over how to split the super dream realm. Wu clan claims thirty percent because it used five Immortal Gu; Luo tribe answers that it contributed just as many; others stress shared immortal essence and Chi Qu You’s role as main arranger. They leave without settling the split.

Righteous path Gu Immortals say that since they started super dream realm exploration, two Gu Immortals have fallen unconscious, one Gu Immortal’s soul was completely destroyed, and a third supreme elder went crazy. Exploration has nothing to do with cultivation level. Ying Wu Xie’s group sees the super Gu formation Chi Qu You set with many Immortal Gu from Southern Border super forces; the dream realm is still expanding, so the formation must be reset at intervals. Ying Wu Xie has lead soul into dream but no method to unravel dreams.

Fang Yuan observes from a nameless peak for half a month. The giant dream realm is completely concealed by the righteous path Gu formation; with the naked eye he sees only a verdant green mountain. He cannot destroy the formation alone, and at least thirteen righteous path Gu Immortals defend inside. Thirteen Southern Border righteous path super forces built it together, each sending at least one Gu Immortal.
Fang Yuan later names the site the super dream realm inside the righteous path Gu formation, and analyzes the immortal opportunity business that sells entry to interact with that dream realm.
He then arrives as Wu clan’s person-in-charge for the super dream realm. Inside the super Gu formation, interior space surrounds the entire super dream realm like a giant city.
